prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any other documents or data in your possession or control. Failure to preserve this material may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
